title: The man in a hat 戴帽子的男士
description: A dialogue in a bookshop: a customer bought two expensive dictionaries half an hour ago but forgot to take them with him. The manager asks Caroline, who served him, but she can't remember because the man she served was wearing a hat. When the customer puts his hat on, Caroline recognizes him. The lesson introduces relative clauses with 'who', 'whom' and 'which', and the words customer, forget, manager, serve, counter and recognize.
answer_note: The listening comprehension question is a model answer (suggested). Workbook A (Complete the dialogue) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-118-123.jpg). Workbook B (Complete the sentences) is partially in the key: items 2-5 are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-118-123.jpg), items 6-10 are model answers (suggested, the workbook key page is incomplete). Grammar I (complete with 'someone who/that...'), II (rewrite with relative clauses) and III (fill in with that/which/who/whom) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.556-557).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away? 听录音，然后回答问题。为什么卡罗琳没有马上认出那位顾客？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。为什么卡罗琳没有马上认出那位顾客？

lesson.text:
CUSTOMER:  I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
MANAGER:   Who served you, sir?
CUSTOMER:  The lady who is standing behind the counter.
MANAGER:   Which books did you buy?
CUSTOMER:  The books which are on the counter.
MANAGER:   Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline? He says he's the man who bought these books.
CAROLINE:  I can't remember. The man who I served was wearing a hat.
MANAGER:   Have you got a hat, sir?
CUSTOMER:  Yes, I have.
MANAGER:   Would you put it on, please?
CUSTOMER:  All right.
MANAGER:   Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
CAROLINE:  Yes. I recognize him now.
lesson.translation:
顾客：半小时以前我买了两本很贵的词典，但是我忘了拿走。
经理：是谁接待您的，先生？
顾客：站在柜台后面的那位女士。
经理：您买的是哪两本书？
顾客：就是柜台上的那两本。
经理：卡罗琳，半小时以前你接待过这位先生吗？他说他就是买这两本书的人。
卡罗琳：我想不起来了。我接待的那个人戴着一顶帽子。
经理：先生，您有一顶帽子吗？
顾客：有。
经理：请您戴上，好吗？
顾客：好。
经理：卡罗琳，这就是你接待过的那个人吗？
卡罗琳：是的。我现在认出他了。

lesson.title: Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away?
lesson.instruction: Answer the question. 回答这个问题。
lesson.context: Comprehension question about why Caroline did not recognize the customer.

questions.prompt: Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away?
questions.answer: Because the customer had taken his hat off, and the man she had served was wearing a hat.

items.title: 1. to take them with me
items.text: to take them with me 把它们带上。them 指“两本词典”。

items.title: 2. The lady who is standing behind the counter.
items.text: 这是一个省略句，完整的句子是“The lady who is standing behind the counter served me.”其中 who is standing behind the counter 是一个以关系代词 who 引导的定语从句，用来修饰前面的名词 the lady。本课带有定语从句的复合句还有：The books which are on the counter; He says he's the man who bought these books; The man who I served was wearing a hat; Is this the man that you served 等。其中 which, who, whom, that 均为关系代词。

items.title: 3. The man who I served was wearing a hat.
items.text: 这是另一个定语从句的例子。由于被修饰的名词 the man 在定语从句中是动词 served 的宾语，因此，关系代词应该用宾格 whom，但在口语中往往用主格 who。

questions.prompt: A teacher is ___ (teach).
A nurse is ___ (look after sick people).
questions.answer: someone who/that looks after sick people.

questions.prompt: A tailor is ___ (make clothes).
A cook is ___ (cook food).
A mechanic is ___ (repair machines).
A sailor is ___ (sail on a ship).
questions.answer: someone who/that sails on a ship.

questions.prompt: A carpenter is ___ (make things with wood).
questions.answer: someone who/that makes things with wood.

questions.prompt: A gardener is ___ (work in a garden).

grammar.title: Grammar II: Rewrite the sentences according to the example (relative clauses)
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句改写下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句改写下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.557 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 rewrite items forming relative clauses with who/whom/which/that; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I saw those men yesterday. (Those/the men)
questions.answer: Those are the men who(m)/that I saw yesterday.

questions.prompt: She served me last week. (That/the assistant)
questions.answer: That is the assistant who(m)/that served me last week.

questions.prompt: That mechanic repaired my car. (That/the mechanic)
questions.answer: That is the mechanic who(m)/that repaired my car.

questions.prompt: We visited that house a month ago. (That/the house)
questions.answer: That is the house that/which we visited a month ago.

questions.prompt: That dog chased our cat on Saturday. (That/the dog)
questions.answer: That is the dog that/which chased our cat on Saturday.

questions.prompt: I bought these magazines yesterday. (These/magazines)
questions.answer: These are the magazines which/that I bought yesterday.

questions.prompt: My father wants to buy that car. (That/the car)
questions.answer: That is the car that/which my father wants to buy.

questions.prompt: The policeman caught that thief last night. (That/thief)
questions.answer: That is the thief who(m)/that the policeman caught last night.
